rows.secureboot: Boot > CSM: Disabled; Boot > Secure Boot > OS Type: Windows UEFI mode (laptops: Security > Secure Boot Control)
rows.tpm: Intel: Advanced > PCH-FW Configuration > PTT: Enable. AMD: Advanced > AMD fTPM Configuration > TPM Device Selection: Firmware TPM
rows.virtualization: Intel: Advanced > CPU Configuration > Intel Virtualization Technology. AMD: Advanced > CPU Configuration > SVM Mode
rows.iommu: Intel: Advanced > System Agent (SA) Configuration > VT-d. AMD: Advanced > AMD CBS > NBIO Common Options > IOMMU
rows.flash_tool: EZ Flash (Tool > ASUS EZ Flash Utility)

rows.secureboot: Settings > Advanced > Windows OS Configuration > BIOS UEFI/CSM Mode: UEFI, then Secure Boot: Enabled (laptops: Security > Secure Boot)
rows.tpm: Settings > Security > Trusted Computing > Security Device Support: Enable (AMD fTPM or Intel PTT)
rows.virtualization: Intel: OC > CPU Features > Intel Virtualization Tech. AMD: OC > Advanced CPU Configuration > SVM Mode
rows.iommu: Intel: OC > CPU Features > Intel VT-D Tech. AMD: Settings > Advanced > AMD CBS > NBIO Common Options > IOMMU
rows.flash_tool: M-Flash (button on the left side of the BIOS screen)

rows.secureboot: Boot > CSM Support: Disabled; Boot > Secure Boot > Secure Boot: Enabled
rows.tpm: Settings > Miscellaneous > Intel Platform Trust Technology (PTT) or AMD CPU fTPM: Enabled
rows.virtualization: Intel: Tweaker > Advanced CPU Settings > Intel Virtualization Technology. AMD: Tweaker > Advanced CPU Settings > SVM Mode
rows.iommu: Settings > Miscellaneous > Intel VT-d or IOMMU: Enabled
rows.flash_tool: Q-Flash (press End, or click Q-Flash at the top)

rows.secureboot: Boot > CSM: Disabled; Security > Secure Boot: Enabled (Secure Boot Mode: Standard)
rows.tpm: Security > Intel Platform Trust Technology or AMD fTPM switch: Enabled (older boards: Advanced > CPU Configuration)
rows.virtualization: Advanced > CPU Configuration > Intel Virtualization Technology or SVM Mode: Enabled
rows.iommu: Intel: Advanced > Chipset Configuration > VT-d. AMD: Advanced > AMD CBS > NBIO Common Options > IOMMU

rows.key: F2 (F12 opens the one-time boot menu)
rows.secureboot: Boot Configuration > Enable Secure Boot: ON (older BIOS: General > Boot Sequence: UEFI, then Secure Boot > Secure Boot Enable)
rows.virtualization: Virtualization Support > Intel Virtualization Technology (or AMD-V): ON
rows.iommu: Virtualization Support > VT for Direct I/O: ON (also Pre-boot / OS Kernel DMA Support if shown)
rows.flash_tool: the BIOS update file from dell.com/support (or F12 menu > BIOS Flash Update with a USB stick)

rows.key: Esc, then F10 (or F10 right away)
rows.secureboot: System Configuration > Boot Options > Secure Boot: Enabled, Legacy Support: Disabled (business PCs: Advanced > Secure Boot Configuration)
rows.tpm: Security > TPM Embedded Security > TPM Device: Available, TPM State: Enabled
rows.virtualization: System Configuration > Virtualization Technology: Enabled (business PCs: Advanced > System Options)
rows.iommu: System Configuration or Advanced > System Options > VTd / AMD IOMMU / DMA Protection (some consumer models hide it)
rows.flash_tool: the BIOS update from support.hp.com or the HP Support Assistant app

rows.key: F2 or Fn+F2 (ThinkPad/ThinkCentre: F1; some laptops: the small Novo button)
rows.secureboot: Security > Secure Boot: Enabled; Boot > Boot Mode: UEFI
rows.tpm: Security > Intel Platform Trust Technology / AMD fTPM / Security Chip: Enabled
rows.virtualization: Configuration > Intel Virtual Technology or AMD SVM Technology: Enabled (ThinkPad: Security > Virtualization)
rows.iommu: Configuration > Intel VT-d / AMD IOMMU if shown (ThinkPad: Security > Virtualization > VT-d, Kernel DMA Protection)
rows.flash_tool: Lenovo Vantage > System Update, or the BIOS update file from pcsupport.lenovo.com

rows.secureboot: Boot > Boot Mode: UEFI, then Secure Boot: Enabled (if it is grey: set a Supervisor Password in Security first and write it down)
rows.tpm: Security or Advanced > TPM / Intel PTT / AMD fTPM: Enabled
rows.virtualization: Main or Advanced > Intel Virtualization Technology or AMD-V / SVM: Enabled
rows.iommu: Main or Advanced > Intel VT-d or AMD IOMMU, if shown
rows.flash_tool: the BIOS update file from acer.com/support (run it in Windows with the charger plugged in)

rows.key: Del or F2 (the start screen often shows it; some laptops use F1, F10, F12 or Esc)
rows.secureboot: Boot or Security > Secure Boot: Enabled; CSM / Legacy: Disabled; Boot Mode: UEFI
rows.tpm: Security or Advanced > TPM / Firmware TPM / fTPM (AMD) / PTT (Intel): Enabled
rows.virtualization: Advanced > CPU Configuration > SVM Mode (AMD) or Intel Virtualization Technology (VT-x): Enabled
rows.iommu: Advanced or Chipset > IOMMU / AMD-Vi (AMD) or VT-d (Intel): Enabled
rows.flash_tool: the BIOS flash tool built into the BIOS, or the update file from the maker's support page
